pose_trail_min_step_m.description: Minimum spacing (m) between pose-trail samples; the trail grounds a blind retrace-reverse as known-free.

pose_trail_len.description: ~1.3 m of travel at the spacing above

rev_steer_deg.description: Road-wheel steering angle (deg) held while reversing out; was a normalised fraction of full lock.

k_turn_min_s.description: Minimum K-turn duration (s) at OBSTACLE risk; converted to control ticks at load.

k_turn_fit_rear_gap.description: Cap the K-turn reverse by the rear room the LIDAR measures; a ceiling, not a replacement. Obstacles only.

obstacles_k_turn_fit_rear_gap.description: Obstacles-only override of k_turn_fit_rear_gap: cap the K-turn reverse by the rear room the LIDAR actually measures.

side_correction_steer_deg.description: Road-wheel steering angle (deg) for a side-threat correction; was a normalised fraction of full lock.

side_correction_speed.description: Forward speed during a side-threat correction

side_correction_blends.description: Let a FORWARD side correction bias the planned steering instead of replacing it. Ships off; refuted.

tick_router_during_maneuver.description: Keep feeding the sign router while a maneuver holds the chassis. Ships off and unvalidated.

escalate_after_attempts.description: Consecutive escapes before escalating (longer duration, opposite side)

escape_side_commit_attempts.description: Attempts spent on one side before trying the other (1 = alternate every attempt, which cancels itself out)

max_escape_s.description: Hard cap on any single escalated escape duration

stuck_escalation_per_attempt_s.description: Time added to a stuck-reverse duration per repeated attempt

stuck_history_floor_s.description: Minimum position history kept, even when timeout*2 is smaller

min_history_for_distance.description: Position samples needed before recent-movement distance is trusted.

escape_mirrors_reverse.description: Steer the opposite way on an escape's reverse leg so forward and reverse arcs accumulate rotation. False shared, true for Obstacles.

obstacles_escape_mirrors_reverse.description: Obstacles-only override of escape_mirrors_reverse: steer the opposite way on the escape's reverse leg.

escape_side_follows_committed_sign.description: Steer a K-turn toward the router's committed pass side instead of the more open LIDAR sector. Ships off.

obstacles_escape_side_follows_committed_.description: Obstacles-only override of escape_side_follows_committed_sign: steer the K-turn toward the side the router committed to passing on.

escape_side_override_min_clearance_m.description: Absolute clearance (m) the router's side must already have before it may be forced; not a margin between sides.

side_correction_follows_committed_sign.description: Let the router's committed pass side outrank steering away from the threat in a side correction. Ships off.

obstacles_side_correction_follows_commit.description: Obstacles value for side_correction_follows_committed_sign; only Obstacles has a committed pass side.

escape_retires_committed_sign.description: Retire the router's committed sign when an escape latches, so the plan it returns to is not the one that drove into it. Ships off.
